Fast shipping. Great service. Easy assemble. Strong and sturdy make. Great product, very happy.

The dip bar far exceeded my expectations. The build quality is far better than other dip bars I looked at prior to my purchase. It is stable, strong, and adjustable. I absolutely love it! It’s a welcome addition to my home gym..
The parallel bars are stable, height adjustable, great for workouts!

Nel complesso un buon prodotto, robusto, stabile e massiccio. Prezzo quasi imbattibile. Quello che non ho apprezzato la mancanza delle chiavi necessarie per l'assemblaggio, una maggiore cura nell'imballaggio (alcuni componenti erano segnati, forse per l'imballaggio o per il trasporto). Un'altra considerazione personale, le barre delle parallele si appoggiano sui pilastri portanti e poi vengono assicurate stringendo delle placche metalliche; avrei preferito, per una maggiore sicurezza, che si incastrassero ai pilastri e poi venissero assicurate stringendo le piastre. Con il mio pavimento, i piedini in plastica proteggono da eventuali graffi ma tendono a scivolare anche se non ho mai avuto pericolo di ribaltamento della struttura.
These things are huge; know that before getting them. They will hold you up, and fun for all ages.

Given the low price, I didn't have high expectations. Needed a drafting table and figured that it would do. Was surprised at how nice it is. Everything went together easily, and the result is a very stable solid table that looks exactly like the photo. Free delivery to my door within 2 days of ordering it as well.

What a fail. The desk size is about 2 or 3 in short of fitting your standard engineering or surveying plot. As an accent piece, it's probably nice, but it's missing the elements that would make it a useful piece of furniture.

Der Tisch ist zum Zeichnen eigentlich sehr schön, allerdings vibriert die Platte beim Schraffieren ziemlich. Abzüge in meiner Bewertung gibt es außerdem für fehlende Teile und Abdeckkappen, einen stressigen Zusammenbau und - besonders ärgerlich - einen blöden Klebezettel auf der Arbeitsplatte, der nur mit Benzin abzulösen war.
